provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST cumulative master pump, iteration 2 (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: Cookie attributes tolerate optional whitespace around the semicolon, so a fully flagged cookie must not be reported as missing Secure, HttpOnly or SameSite (old parser reported all three).

groundTruth.rationale: Every attribute is present: Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax. The spaces before the semicolons are RFC 6265 optional whitespace and do not remove the attributes.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic Set-Cookie value, not a live session.
The case proves attribute parsing, not that the server sets this cookie for every session.
